value_or_null.description: This is an observational Vienna medical-record cohort, not randomized prophylaxis. Treatment selection and frequent switching can confound associations. No multivariable adjustment, time-varying exposure analysis or correction for disease activity/response was possible. Observed trends do not establish aspirin harm, DOAC efficacy, noninferiority or a prescribing choice.

Screened293/included208 is not every analyzed risk set. Figure1 diagnosis groups sum202, month3sum200; VTE landmark starts194, anybleeding187, majorbleeding193, calculated from printed group Ns. Six absent baseline exposure records are not assigned to a group. Any-time aspirin89/LMWH55/VKA3/DOAC98 overlap through switching and cannot be summed as unique patients or used as CIF denominators.

Baseline exposure curves follow two years; three-month landmark curves start anew among still-at-risk survivors for the following21months, although abstract calls both two-year rates. Outcome-specific risk sets differ from Figure1 snapshots and each other. Survivor bias and early-event exclusions persist; do not describe both analyses as full208-patient two-year ITT.

No VTE while actually taking DOAC/VKA is not zero VTE in the baseline-DOAC group: its CIF is4%. Medicines switched. Diagnosis/landmark exposure and medicine at event are distinct, without person-time rate or a causal on-treatment model. Grouped agents irrespective of dose are not evidence for a particular apixaban/rivaroxaban/aspirin regimen.

Source paragraph says8patients receiving any thromboprophylaxis at VTE, then9aspirin and2LMWH, with noDOAC/VKA events. Eight cannot be the total of9plus2; retain literal unresolved and do not silently replace8withnone/11 or infer group event counts. Tables total19firstVTE retained.

Any-bleed medicine-at-event counts9none+5aspirin+7LMWH+13DOAC+0VKA total34, versus35patients with bleeding; one status remains unassigned. Four patients died after majorbleeding, while later narrative explicitly identifies3lethal events by drug; do not silently equate death after bleeding with adjudicated fatal-bleeding totals. Major counts6none+1ASA+3LMWH+4DOAC total14.

Text says74.3%of35bleedings within firstyear, arithmetically26, whereasTable2prints25at12months. Preserve both; no silent count correction. VTE16of19by12months agrees84.2%. Recurrent events and overlaps such asPEwithDVT are not separately added to19patients.

SAVED assessed172, versus179everIMiD and208wholecohort. IMPEDE univariate perpointHR1.19CI1.04-1.37P.01/high-low3.99CI1.07-14.88P.04 coexist with overall3categoryP.12 and intermediate-lowP.2. SAVEDHR.97CI.34-2.75P.95 is not proof of equivalence or universal invalidity. No multivariable-adjusted/subdistribution/causal HR claimed.

Gray VTE comparisons baselineP.100 and landmarkP.078 are not statistically established differences. Wider aspirin CIF point estimates do not establish ineffectiveness/harm; zeroDOAClandmark does not prove complete prevention. No pairwise adjusted effect or risk ratio supplied.

Anybleeding GrayP.726baseline and.030landmark; the nominal landmark signal is exploratory without multiplicity correction and not specific to majorbleeding. Majorbleeding GrayP.298/.704, no significant difference is not equal safety/noninferiority. Authors at-least-as-safe statement remains interpretation, not accepted safety claim.

Baseline aspirin majorbleeding3.57%CI2.48-15.72 is transcribed as printed; asymmetry/source lowerbound not silently repaired. DOACbaseline majorbleeding0 contrasts4major events while onDOAC at event and landmarkCIF5.92%, because exposures change. No universal absence of majorbleeding inferred.

Newlydiagnosed single-center cohort includes17priorVTE,17priorarterial events and some nonIMiD treatment, not uniform primary-prophylaxis-only population or every modern myeloma regimen. NoAsianpatients/only3high-dexamethasone cases constrain SAVED applicability. Historical guideline/background claims are not current external verification or new prescription.

Missing data excluded for relevant analyses and LTFU censored; source does not provide all per-analysis missing reasons or verified patient-level adherence. Exclusion specifics, risk-score components and extra comparative exposure tables/figure are external unchecked supplements. Record states not_checked, not inaccessible/no-events.

Exact2025report, Vienna2012-2022cohort, no matched prior intake record. Cited older cohorts/reviews and nexttargetroutineprophylaxis report are separate reports, not assumed shared patients or pooled independent replication. No fresh registry/protocol/correction/retraction query or raw-data check; no completed full scientific review.

Authors explicitly declare no funding for this work. C.A. declares personal fees from Bayer,BMS/Pfizer,DaiichiSankyo,Sanofi; others no relevant conflicts. Independent event adjudicator thanked; no main-text ethics approval/waiver or raw-data sharing details located, not proof they were absent in practice.
